title: deep reinforcement learning for robotic bipedal locomotion: a brief survey
core_idea: A systematic survey that categorises, compares, and analyses deep reinforcement learning frameworks for bipedal locomotion by organising them into end-to-end and hierarchical control schemes, contrasting end-to-end learning approaches with hierarchical layered structures that integrate learning-based and traditional model-based methods, with the goal of guiding development toward a more integrated unified framework.
tldr: Survey of DRL frameworks for bipedal locomotion, organised into end-to-end and hierarchical schemes, aiming to highlight gaps and guide future work toward a unified, broadly applicable framework.
